violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil * was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. - Ice cream scoops were left in the dip well. The water was drained from the dip well, however it looks like the ice cream scoops were not cleaned and had residual dried ice cream on them or there is a significant issue with hard water.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Exposed studs, joists or rafters * were not covered with smooth, nonabsorbent and easily cleanable material. - Closet in the washroom has exposed rafters from the ceiling and the plumbing pipes are exposed as well. No visible signs of dripping from the plumbing pipes, but there are signs of a previous plumbing issue.
